name: Scarlett Wilhelmina Garde
original_name: スカーレット・ウェルヘルミナカーデ
source:
Weak spot: Anal
Fetish: Queen play

A foreign exchange student from America who transfers into [url=/c57067]Kou's[/url] class. She is extremely perverted and assertive, and has one certain wish: she wishes to find herself a loyal dog - in other words, she is into petplay. Because of this, she is very interested in Kou, and wishes to make him her dog. When Scarlett becomes obsessed, she becomes completely dedicated to that thing, which is why she's also dedicated to get her other love rivals out of her way.
